listing.name: Play HQ 1.0 [Mod]
listing.summary: Adds a buildable station that functions as a personal storage and production hub.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a buildable station that functions as a personal storage and production hub.

description:
So let me start by saying this is my first mod ever so don't kill me.

I first started just wanting a place to store items/ships like an abandoned station then one thing lead to another and well here I am with this.

The mod is simple, build a Station called "Player HQ", it has two models, High Tech/Gamma core and Low Tech/Beta core.

(All models and illustrations are from Starsector it self making it a standalone mod.)

The station it self is just an abandoned station that allows you to store items and ships just like an abandoned station but it has other functions as well, I made it this way so it wouldn't get invaded or count as a player colony but still allow you to build ships and weapons.

It can build modules, 6 in total, including but not limited to mining and production that you can install special items into to improve their performance.

[Edit] There is an ability that lets you build the station around planets or in asteroid belts/fields, you can build it around colonized planets which will unlock the use of the Resort.

Cost 50,000 Credits, 6,000 Metals, 1,000 Transplutonics and 600 Volatiles as well as the above mentioned AI core, you can only build one but if you dismantle the old one you can then build it else where, you will get back 50% of the resources(excluding credits) used to build it and any special items used.

I've tested each feature to make sure it works but I haven't ran it though it's paces yet so I am open to feedback and suggestion but please keep in mind I am new to this.

Anyway here is the link to the mod.

Player HQ Github

aiDescription: Allows the player to construct a unique station that serves as a safe haven for storing items and ships without the risk of invasion. The station can be built around planets or in asteroid belts and includes modules for mining and production that can be upgraded with special items.
